entities.name: MAP10
observations: The 768-residue query sequence is identified as microtubule-associated protein 10 (MAP10) with 100% identity and 100% query coverage to reviewed rat MAP10 D3ZAP3.
The query has 82.5% identity and 100% query coverage to reviewed mouse MAP10 Q8BJS7, and 46.0% identity with E-value 3.26e-164 to reviewed human MAP10 Q9P2G4.
MAP10 annotations describe promotion of microtubule stability, mitotic spindle organization, spindle midzone assembly, and normal cytokinesis.
Reported localization includes cytoplasmic microtubules, centrosomes, spindle poles, spindle midzone, and the cytokinetic midbody.
Sequence-derived properties: 768 aa, approximately 83.1 kDa, theoretical pI 8.94, positive charge at pH 7, hydrophilic average GRAVY -0.557, and predicted instability index 66.5.
Pfam scanning detects MAP10_N (PF14924) at residues 30-138 and MAP10_C (PF14925) across residues 240-768.

The sequence lacks evidence in this analysis for transmembrane segments or a catalytic enzyme domain; its basic, modular, low-complexity-rich composition is consistent with a cytoskeletal regulatory protein.
